interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and provide space for a wider sidewalk and a protected bike lane or planting buffer.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to break up the long crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Add a furniture or planting zone between the curb and the walkway to protect pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Expansion and Repair
interventions.description: Construct wide, continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide safe pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Pavement Markings
interventions.description: Narrow the travel lanes with paint, add a center line, and install high-visibility crosswalks at regular intervals.

interventions.title: Streetscape Improvements
interventions.description: Install street trees and a furniture zone to create a physical buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: If this is a frequent crossing point, install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage.

interventions.title: Sidewalk and Curb Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk with a raised curb to provide physical separation and a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of people crossing.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Enhancements
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale lighting to ensure the walkway and any future crossing points are well-illuminated at night.
